$comment: Shared VfSelect cases, rendered by the Vue adapter at the reference commit, by the current Vue adapter, and by the real Razor adapter with its browser controller. The fourth overlay catalog: every listbox is found through its trigger's aria-controls - the one declared edge the extractor follows - and compared where it is. No case is open initially: the select has no open prop. Every Vue select is a v-model consumer; the Razor adapter applies selections itself (platform divergence razor-has-no-controlled-mode). Closed end states converge on the static case of the same content that the gesture has to land on.

propVocabulary.options: The options, { value, label, disabled? }. Static on every target.
propVocabulary.modelValue: string, default ''. The model. The Vue fixture writes update:modelValue back, as v-model does; the Razor adapter reads it as the initial value and applies a selection or a clear itself.
propVocabulary.placeholder: string. Shown while no option is selected, unless a floating field suppresses it.
propVocabulary.leadingIcon: Icon name for the leading adornment.
propVocabulary.trailingIcon: Icon name for the trailing adornment.
propVocabulary.clearable: boolean, default false. The clear button replaces the chevron while the select is filled and enabled.
propVocabulary.disabled: boolean, default false. The native disabled trigger and hidden input.
propVocabulary.placement: 'bottom-start' | 'bottom-end', default 'bottom-start'. floater.js flips within the pair of the same side.
propVocabulary.disableTeleport: boolean, default false. Renders the listbox in place, last in the wrapper.
propVocabulary.teleportTo: Not in the catalog: every case teleports to <body> or renders in place. A named destination is exercised by the Razor browser gate and the characterization suite.

contentVocabulary.field: A real VfField around the one select, { label, placement, description?, error? }; the Vue select is bound to its slot scope (id, aria-describedby, invalid), the Razor select takes them from the render-time field context.
contentVocabulary.form: A form around the case, { reset? } adding a native reset button.
contentVocabulary.popover: A select beside a real VfPopover rendered in place, and a second select inside it; { trigger } is the popover's trigger text. The select beside keeps the declared edge - a select trigger - rendered in every state.
contentVocabulary.after: A consumer control after the roots: `control` is a real consumer button, the target of an outside click.
contentVocabulary.leading: The leading slot: `text` in a plain span.
contentVocabulary.trailing: The trailing slot: `text` in a plain span.

groupVocabulary: A list of sibling selects rendered side by side in one case, each with its own props; the case-level props are ignored, the attrs and content apply to each.

ownershipVocabulary.componentInteractive: The exact number of controls the component itself renders: one <button> trigger per instance, the clear button while shown, and every <button role=option> of an open listbox, disabled ones included.
ownershipVocabulary.consumerInteractive: The exact number of consumer focusable elements in the case and in its open listboxes: an after control, a reset button, a popover trigger and an open popover panel. A hidden input is not focusable.
ownershipVocabulary.consumerInteractiveRoles: The exact number of consumer elements carrying an explicit interactive role: none. The options carry role=option and are the component's own, counted by the profile's declared role; the listbox container is the select's structural overlay node, as the dropdown's role=menu is.

interactionVocabulary.$comment: A case with an `interaction` is driven with real pointer and key events, alone on the page with its followed targets, then re-measured: snapshot, DOM (with the followed listbox) and accessibility tree. The snapshot waits, bounded, for every enter or leave to finish.
interactionVocabulary.steps: clickButton (a real pointer click at the element's centre; `selector` is button.vf-select, .vf-select-wrap__clear, .vf-popover__trigger, .parity-after-control or .parity-reset-control, `index` picks a match; with `through`, the search is inside the listbox the trigger's aria-controls reaches), focusButton (likewise), pressKey with ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End, Enter, Space, Escape or Tab, wait (`ms`). Tab never leaves the document, and every fixture swallows the browser default of a navigation key or Escape the product left unhandled - after recording that it did.
interactionVocabulary.expect: Claims about the snapshot fields of the same name, or `a11y:<role>.<state>` about the tree read after the gesture. `transitions` lists every enter and leave completed since the first input, bucketed: short under 300 ms, normal under 480 ms.
interactionVocabulary.matches: The closed case of the same content whose fresh render the gesture has to land on.

cases.title: Closed, nothing selected: the trigger alone, aria-controls naming a listbox that does not exist
cases.$why: The closed half of the relationship contract: aria-controls dangles on every target and no listbox is anywhere in the document. No name, so no hidden input.
